faq.a: Brains love new and interesting things, so they jump around. Every mind wanders sometimes. It is not something you did wrong.

faq.q: How do I notice my mind wandering?
faq.a: Ask yourself now and then, Where is my mind? If it is somewhere else, you noticed. Well done, that is the first step.

faq.q: What helps me find my place?
faq.a: Put your finger or a ruler under the line you are reading. Then your eyes know where to go back to.
asks: Tell me about Finger on the line

faq.q: What do I say to bring my mind back?
faq.a: Say one kind word in your head, like Back, or Here. Then look at your work again.

faq.q: What if my mind wanders a lot?
faq.a: That is okay. Each time you bring it back, you are training your focus, like a muscle. A grown-up you trust can help you find more tricks.

facts: Scientists have found that everyone's mind wanders often during the day.
Noticing that your mind has wandered is the first step to bringing it back.
